meta.title: Zambia Government Operating Model
meta.baseline: Government Scope Reference Model - International Baseline (14 domains, 91 SAs, 501 concepts)
meta.note: Built from the international baseline + Zambia mapping, per the answered decision register (artifact 48KKXwXqNYgkmwNDGdXg7i). The 8 grade-A entities had their source links and Act names independently opened and confirmed on 28 Oct 2026 (7 Acts verified; the pensions entry corrected to the Public Service Pensions Fund). The 5 grade-C and 3 external entities are NOT primary-verified, and whole-of-government reconciliation (Yellow Book, PACRA, cabinet gazette, Constitution, local-authority and traditional registers) remains in the validation backlog. Every entity carries its evidence grade. v1.1.0 adds the two source figures and the Zambia-structure-to-generic mapping (institutional groupings, cross-reference side rails, digital overlay).

domains.name: Constitutional Governance & Public Administration
domains.boundary: The constitutional state, democratic institutions, public authority, policy, identity and the government-constituent relationship.

concept_families.name: Traditional & Customary Governance
concept_families.note: Not folded into local government without constitutional/statutory evidence (resolution rule 6).

domains.name: External Relations, International Trade & Development Cooperation
domains.boundary: Formal relations and exchanges between the jurisdiction and foreign states or international bodies.

domains.name: Defence & National Security
domains.boundary: Protection of national sovereignty against strategic, military and intelligence threats.

domains.name: Justice, Public Safety, Civil Protection & Migration
domains.boundary: Domestic law enforcement, adjudication, corrections, migration control and emergency protection.

domains.name: Public Finance, Revenue & Economic Stewardship
domains.boundary: Sovereign fiscal policy, public revenue, treasury, debt, public investment and monetary stewardship.

domains.name: Economy, Industry, Labour, Agriculture & Regional Development
domains.boundary: Productive sectors, employment, enterprise, markets and economic development.

domains.name: Environment, Climate & Natural Resources
domains.boundary: Natural systems, environmental condition, climate, resources, pollution and waste.

domains.name: Land, Housing, Built Environment & Communities
domains.boundary: Rights in land, spatial development, buildings, housing and place-based community assets.

concept_families.name: Traditional Area / Chiefdom
concept_families.note: Zambia specialization of Administrative Area/Jurisdiction, not a new domain.

domains.name: Transport, Mobility, Logistics & Communications Infrastructure

domains.boundary: Population health, care delivery, health providers, clinical products and health-system outcomes.

concept_families.name: Health Insurance Membership & Claim

concept_families.note: Supports NAPSA and the public-service pension implementations.

domains.name: Government Enterprise Operations & Digital Enablement
domains.boundary: Internal operation of public-sector entities; excludes sovereign fiscal, sector and constituent records owned elsewhere.

entity_types.definition: Highest-order constitutional division of state authority
Public office created directly by the Constitution
Collegial institution established constitutionally with defined public powers
Cabinet portfolio and central executive organization for a sphere of policy
Administrative unit performing a defined mandate within a ministry or public institution
Body corporate established by an Act for a defined mandate
entity_types.basis: Establishing Act; usually linked to an oversight ministry

entity_types.definition: Statutory entity empowered to license, supervise, inspect, set rules or enforce
Statutory governing, advisory, professional or sector body
Territorial public authority governing a defined local jurisdiction

entity_types.scope: Zambia implementation of a wider generic concept

entity_types.definition: Incorporated enterprise subject to material state ownership or control
entity_types.basis: Companies legislation, establishing Act, ownership instrument

entity_types.definition: Statutory institution administering contributions, benefits, insurance or earmarked finance
Publicly established tertiary or specialist education institution
Institution providing common digital, data, hosting or administrative services
Time-bounded governance or delivery structure, not a permanent public body
Company controlled through public shareholding, separate corporate personality
Private, nonprofit, research or development organization in public delivery
entity_types.scope: Outside government scope unless separately public-controlled

resolution_rules: Official statistics stewardship sits in Domain 1 (not Education/Research or Domain 14); technology platforms for statistics stay in Domain 14.
A regulator is placed in its regulated-sector domain; licensing, inspection and enforcement are mapped as capabilities, not Subject Areas.
A public enterprise uses its operating sector as primary placement; state ownership and fiscal-risk relationships are recorded separately against Domain 5.
Smart Zambia Institute is placed in Domain 14, even though its services support every domain.
The data-protection body is placed in Domain 1 (public oversight); privacy controls and incidents cross-reference Domain 14.
Traditional governance is not subsumed under local government without explicit constitutional or statutory evidence.
A ministry can change name or portfolio while its Domains and Subject Areas remain stable (entity vs mandate).

entities.name: Zambia Statistics Agency (ZamStats)

entities.note: Reconciliation resolved: CSO is the former name; ZamStats is current.

entities.name: Zambia Revenue Authority

entities.name: ZAMNET Communication Systems Limited
entities.instrument: Incorporated 1994 under the Companies Act; wholly owned by the University of Zambia
entities.note: Public at one remove (owned by a public university). Instrument not opened.

entities.name: University of Zambia
entities.instrument: University of Zambia Act 1965; operates within Higher Education Act No. 4 of 2013 (primary source not opened this pass)
entities.source: no primary source opened - graded conservatively
entities.note: Chase the University of Zambia Act / HEA register to lift C→A/B.

entities.name: Zambia Centre for Accountancy Studies (statutory body)
entities.instrument: Zambia Centre for Accountancy Studies Act, Cap 391 (Act text not opened this pass)

entities.name: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
entities.instrument: Data Protection Act No. 3 of 2021 s.4(1): 'established in the Ministry responsible for communications the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner'
entities.note: D7 resolved: correct legal name is 'Office of the Data Protection Commissioner'; 'Data Protection Commission' is a loose/incorrect label. Carried in the inception backlog to confirm succession and any amendment.

entities.name: Centre for Infectious Disease Research in Zambia
entities.note: Outside the public-sector inventory (private NGO) - recorded as external partner.

entities.name: Liquid Intelligent Technologies (Zambia) Ltd
entities.instrument: Private subsidiary under the Companies Act (Cassava/Liquid group)
entities.note: Private operator - excluded from the public-sector inventory (flag confirmed).

entities.name: ZCAS University Limited
entities.instrument: Incorporated 2016 under the Companies Act; registered under Higher Education Act No. 4 of 2013
entities.note: Private degree-awarding arm of ZCAS - recorded as external; the statutory ZCAS body (Cap 391) is in the inventory.
